caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object resembling a metallic or glass lamp base or decorative finial, centrally placed on a beige or light tan background. The object is vertically oriented and features a wide, four-sided base that gradually narrows as it rises. The stem is tapered and faceted, leading to a spherical upper section adorned with concentric circular patterns or raised medallions. The topmost part of the object has a small, layered cylindrical detail, possibly a fitting or cap, rendered in darker shades. The overall color scheme is primarily grayscale with white highlights indicating reflective surfaces, suggesting a shiny, polished material. The object is outlined in fine lines and shaded to indicate volume and depth. There is a handwritten signature "LAWRENCE PHILLIPS" in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Lamp
